messages.subject: University Survey
parts:
Hello=2C

my name is Craig and I am a third year student currently studying Product I=
nnovation at the University of Hull. For my final year project I am conduct=
ing a detailed study into how Subjective Risk can affect Product Design=2C =
and as part of this project I am conducting an electronic survey regarding =
public risk perceptions. In order to obtain a substantial set of results=2C=
I need participants from a range of different demograhics and was hoping t=
hat you may complete my survey. All results are completely anonomous and th=
ere are no personal or intrusive questions involved.

I understand that you are undoubtebly busy or may not want/be interested in=
particpating in such a survey which is completely understandable. However =
if you are willing to participate=2C your help is greatly appreciated and w=
ill significantly help me to progress my project and achieve an outcome of =
a high level.

The survey is entirely web-based and consists of rating a range of products=
/activities against a number of risk-related attributes. The survey should =
take no longer than 15 minutes to complete and no prior knowledge regarding=
the subject area is required.

=20

If you are willing to participate simply click the link below and you will =
be taken directly to the survey.

Thank you for your time and thank you in advance to those of you that fill =
out my survey.

=20

Regards

Craig=20
